points.K5: 有限空间作业的安全要求
points.K11: 化学品安全技术说明书
points.S2: 化学品小量溢洒用处置包
points.S3: 洗眼器和喷淋定期检查
points.S4: 手套箱长时间操作的工效

shots.scene: 欣欣坐在面试桌一侧，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot sits at one side of an interview table and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天来一场安全员模拟面试，二十问。
overlay: 安全员模拟面试二十问

shots.scene: 一行图标：思考气泡、笔记本、对勾
shots.prompt_en: A row of icons: a thought bubble, a notebook and a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 先想、再写、后对照。

shots.scene: 学院走廊海报：招募学生安全员（空白海报）
shots.prompt_en: A blank recruitment poster for student safety officers in a college corridor.
shots.narration: 学院招学生安全员，小研报了名。

shots.scene: 王老师和小研对坐，桌上一叠空白题卡
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator sits across from the female graduate student with a stack of blank question cards.
shots.narration: 王老师来一场模拟面试。

shots.scene: 小研在本子上写下自己的答案
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes her own answers in a notebook before looking up.
shots.narration: 每题先自己想、写下来，再听答案。

shots.section_title: 空气里的氧气约占五分之一
shots.scene: 空气成分饼图，氧气占一小块
shots.prompt_en: A pie chart of air composition with oxygen as a small slice. No text.
shots.narration: 第一问：空气里氧气占多少？
overlay: 空气里的氧气约占五分之一

shots.section_title: 空气里的氧气约占五分之一
shots.scene: 欣欣比出五指，弯下四指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up one finger out of five.
shots.narration: 约百分之二十一，五分之一左右。

shots.section_title: 空气里的氧气约占五分之一
shots.scene: 氧含量降低时人形图标头晕
shots.prompt_en: A person icon becomes dizzy as the oxygen slice shrinks. No people.
shots.narration: 比它低就可能缺氧。

shots.scene: 风机通过软管向检修井送风
shots.prompt_en: A blower pushes fresh air through a duct into a maintenance hatch. No people.
shots.narration: 第二问：有限空间怎么通风？

shots.scene: 进风和排风两个箭头形成对流
shots.prompt_en: Supply and exhaust arrows create airflow through a confined space. No people.
shots.narration: 用送风机和排风扇，进出形成对流。

shots.scene: 焊接点四周：灭火器、看火人、防火毯、防护用品
shots.prompt_en: Around a welding spot: an extinguisher, a fire watcher, a fire blanket and protective gear. No people.
shots.narration: 第三问：焊接作业要准备什么？

shots.scene: 气体检测仪和水带图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a gas detector and a fire hose. No people.
shots.narration: 还要测可燃气体，备好消防水。

shots.section_title: 有限空间作业的安全要求
shots.scene: 检修井口：作业票、检测仪、监护人和登记表
shots.prompt_en: At a hatch: a permit form, a gas detector, an attendant with a blank log sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 第四问：有限空间作业要哪些条件？
overlay: 有限空间作业的安全要求

shots.section_title: 有限空间作业的安全要求
shots.scene: 呼吸器、安全带和救援绳、气笛图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a breathing apparatus, a harness with rescue rope and an air horn. No people.
shots.narration: 呼吸器、救援绳、报警器，都要备好。

shots.scene: 有限空间剖面：缺氧、毒气、积水湿滑、昏暗
shots.prompt_en: A confined space cross-section showing low oxygen, toxic gas, a slippery wet floor and darkness. No people.
shots.narration: 第五问：有限空间有哪些危害？

shots.scene: 欣欣点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods.
shots.narration: 缺氧、毒气、易燃、滑倒、照明差。

shots.scene: 作业被切成步骤方块，每块下面危害和盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A task cut into step blocks, each with a hazard icon and a shield below. No people.
shots.narration: 第六问：什么是工作安全分析？

shots.scene: 分析表附在作业票后，王老师给工人讲解
shots.prompt_en: An analysis sheet stapled to a permit; the safety administrator explains it to workers.
shots.narration: 附在作业票上，讲给每个作业人员。

shots.scene: 五级台阶图标：创可贴、医生、限制工作、停工、黑丝带
shots.prompt_en: Five steps of icons: a bandage, a doctor, restricted work, a lost-time calendar and a black ribbon. No people.
shots.narration: 第七问：伤害事故分哪几类？

shots.scene: 国内事故分类书和图章
shots.prompt_en: A closed blank book with a stamp icon. No people.
shots.narration: 国内分类按国家标准，以现行文本为准。

shots.scene: 分数线图标：上面伤害次数，下面总工时
shots.prompt_en: A fraction icon: injury count on top, total work hours below. No text.
shots.narration: 第八问：伤害率怎么算？

shots.scene: 两个单位的柱子被折算到同一高度比较
shots.prompt_en: Two organizations' bars are scaled to a common base for comparison. No text.
shots.narration: 按工时折算，大小单位才能比较。

shots.scene: 分数线图标：上面损失天数，下面总工时
shots.prompt_en: A fraction icon: lost days on top, total work hours below. No text.
shots.narration: 第九问：严重率怎么算？

shots.scene: 欣欣举牌
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank sign.
shots.narration: 看损失多少天，反映伤得多重。

shots.section_title: 化学品安全技术说明书
shots.scene: 化学品安全技术说明书文件夹
shots.prompt_en: A binder of blank chemical safety data sheets on a lab shelf. No people.
shots.narration: 第十问：MSDS是什么？
overlay: 化学品安全技术说明书

shots.section_title: 化学品安全技术说明书
shots.scene: 小研翻到急救和泄漏处置部分
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens the binder to the first aid and spill sections.
shots.narration: 现在叫SDS，用前要读。

shots.scene: 井内淡淡的蒸气云，排风扇把它抽走
shots.prompt_en: A faint vapor cloud inside a pit is drawn out by an exhaust fan. No people.
shots.narration: 第十一问：有限空间的蒸气云怎么清？

shots.scene: 加热区域的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of heating the area, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 用排风扇，绝不能加热。

shots.scene: 有限空间里的低压照明灯
shots.prompt_en: A low-voltage work light inside a confined space. No people.
shots.narration: 第十二问：有限空间用多高电压？

shots.scene: 一本书和图章
shots.prompt_en: A closed blank book with a stamp icon. No people.
shots.narration: 用安全电压，数值按国家标准。

shots.scene: 浓度标尺，低端一条红线标着爆炸下限
shots.prompt_en: A concentration scale with a red line near the low end marking the lower explosive limit. No people.
shots.narration: 第十三问：LEL是什么？

shots.scene: 浓度越过红线，遇火花爆燃的图标
shots.prompt_en: Concentration rises past the red line and a spark causes a flash. No people.
shots.narration: 可燃气能被点燃的最低浓度。

shots.scene: 检测仪报警，人员撤离
shots.prompt_en: A gas detector alarms well below the red line and people leave. No people.
shots.narration: 远没到下限就要报警撤离。

shots.scene: 井下有人倒下，监护人跳下的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an attendant jumping into a pit after a collapsed worker, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 第十四问：监护人能进去救人吗？

shots.scene: 监护人在井口打电话呼救
shots.prompt_en: The attendant stays at the hatch and calls for help on a phone.
shots.narration: 不能。呼叫他人和专业救援队。

shots.scene: 实验楼报警，小研关掉设备
shots.prompt_en: An alarm sounds in the lab building; the female graduate student switches off her equipment.
shots.narration: 第十五问：气体泄漏时怎么办？

shots.scene: 风向袋，人员往上风向撤到集合点
shots.prompt_en: A windsock shows wind direction; people walk upwind to an assembly point.
shots.narration: 停止作业、关设备、看风向撤离。

shots.scene: 集合点清点人数，报告负责人
shots.prompt_en: People are counted at the assembly point while the older man reports by phone.
shots.narration: 到集合点报到，报告负责人。

shots.scene: 刷满漆的木梯，裂纹被盖住的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a fully painted wooden ladder hiding a crack, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 第十六问：梯子能刷漆吗？

shots.scene: 透明保护层下能看见木纹和裂纹
shots.prompt_en: A ladder with a clear coating where wood grain and a small crack remain visible. No people.
shots.narration: 不刷不透明漆，免得盖住裂纹。

shots.scene: 吊具上的额定载荷标牌（图标）
shots.prompt_en: A lifting sling with a rated load tag showing a weight icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第十七问：什么是安全工作载荷？

shots.scene: 超过标牌的重物打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a load heavier than the tag, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 允许承受的最大载荷，不能超。

shots.scene: 地面被挖出的沟槽和坑
shots.prompt_en: A trench and a pit dug into the ground. No people.
shots.narration: 第十八问：什么是开挖？

shots.scene: 欣欣指着坑
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the pit.
shots.narration: 在地面挖出的坑、槽、切口都算。

shots.scene: 岩石、黏土、砂土三种剖面
shots.prompt_en: Three soil cross-sections: rock, clay and loose sand. No people.
shots.narration: 第十九问：土有哪几类？

shots.scene: 专业人员查看土壁，旁边国标书
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer examines a soil wall beside a closed standard book.
shots.narration: 土质不同支护不同，由专业人员判定。

shots.scene: 护栏：上横杆、中横杆、挡脚板、立杆
shots.prompt_en: A guardrail showing a top rail, a mid rail, a toe-board and posts. No people.
shots.narration: 第二十问：什么是护栏系统？

shots.scene: 护栏挡住人和工具不掉下
shots.prompt_en: The guardrail stops a person icon and a falling tool at an edge. No people.
shots.narration: 挡住人，也挡住工具材料坠落。

shots.scene: 深夜实验室里只有阿杰一人在做危险实验，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a student alone in a dark lab at night doing a hazardous experiment, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 危险实验，不要一个人做。

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰两人一起做，门口登记
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student work together; their names are on a blank log at the door.
shots.narration: 至少两人在场，登记去向。

shots.scene: 老周在手机上确认学生已离开实验室
shots.prompt_en: The older man checks his phone confirming the students have finished and left.
shots.narration: 夜间节假日，按规定报备。

shots.section_title: 化学品小量溢洒用处置包
shots.scene: 实验台上一小摊溶剂洒出
shots.prompt_en: A small solvent spill on a lab bench. No people.
shots.narration: 试剂洒了一小摊，别慌。
overlay: 化学品小量溢洒用处置包

shots.section_title: 化学品小量溢洒用处置包
shots.scene: 小研戴好手套，打开应急处置包，用吸附棉围住
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wears gloves, opens a spill kit and surrounds the spill with absorbent pads.
shots.narration: 戴防护，用处置包从外向内吸附。

shots.section_title: 化学品小量溢洒用处置包
shots.scene: 吸附物装进废物袋，贴标签
shots.prompt_en: Used absorbent goes into a labeled waste bag. No people.
shots.narration: 收集后按危险废物处置，报告负责人。

shots.section_title: 化学品小量溢洒用处置包
shots.scene: 大量溢洒时人员撤离、电话图标
shots.prompt_en: For a large spill, people leave the room and a telephone icon appears. No people.
shots.narration: 量大、气味重，立即撤离报告。

shots.section_title: 洗眼器和喷淋定期检查
shots.scene: 洗眼器和紧急喷淋装置
shots.prompt_en: An eyewash station and an emergency shower in a laboratory. No people.
shots.narration: 洗眼器和喷淋，关键时刻救命。
overlay: 洗眼器和喷淋定期检查

shots.section_title: 洗眼器和喷淋定期检查
shots.scene: 小研按下洗眼器放水检查
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student activates the eyewash to flush and check the water flow.
shots.narration: 定期放水，检查出水和水质。

shots.section_title: 洗眼器和喷淋定期检查
shots.scene: 喷淋下方堆着纸箱，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Boxes piled under an emergency shower, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 周围不堆杂物，通道畅通。

shots.section_title: 洗眼器和喷淋定期检查
shots.scene: 一本书和图章
shots.prompt_en: A closed blank book with a stamp icon. No people.
shots.narration: 设备要求按国家标准，以现行文本为准。

shots.section_title: 手套箱长时间操作的工效
shots.scene: 小研双臂伸进手套箱操作，肩膀耸起，肩颈红点
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works with both arms in a glove box, shoulders raised, neck and shoulders glowing red.
shots.narration: 手套箱里长时间伸臂操作，肩颈很累。
overlay: 手套箱长时间操作的工效

shots.section_title: 手套箱长时间操作的工效
shots.scene: 调高座椅，让手套口与肩同高
shots.prompt_en: She adjusts a stool so the glove ports are level with her shoulders.
shots.narration: 调好座椅高度，手套口与肩平齐。

shots.section_title: 手套箱长时间操作的工效
shots.scene: 物品提前在箱内摆在近处
shots.prompt_en: Tools and vials are placed close to the glove ports inside the box. No people.
shots.narration: 物品提前放近，少伸臂、少扭身。

shots.section_title: 手套箱长时间操作的工效
shots.scene: 小研抽出双手休息，转动肩膀
shots.prompt_en: She withdraws her arms, rests and rolls her shoulders.
shots.narration: 分段操作，定时抽手休息。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，白板上思考气泡和对勾
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a whiteboard with a thought bubble and check marks.
shots.narration: 二十问，答案要讲得出为什么。

shots.scene: 风机、检测仪、监护人图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blower, a gas detector and an attendant. No people.
shots.narration: 有限空间：通风、检测、监护、不盲救。

shots.scene: 分数线和SDS图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fraction and a data sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 伤害率按工时折算，用前读SDS。

shots.scene: 两人实验、处置包、洗眼器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of two people working, a spill kit and an eyewash. No people.
shots.narration: 危险实验两人做，处置包和洗眼器常检查。

shots.scene: 王老师和小研握手，欣欣挥手
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator shakes hands with the female graduate student while the panda mascot waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 答得出，更要做得到！
